```bash
# Add RVM to PATH for scripting. Make sure this is the last PATH variable change.
export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.rvm/bin"

# add iCommands Path
```

#### Starship Configuration

```toml
format = """
[](#253494)\
$username\
[](bg:#2c7fb8 fg:#253494)\
$directory\
[](fg:#2c7fb8 bg:#41b6c4)\
$git_branch\
$git_status\
[](fg:#41b6c4 bg:#a1dab4)\
$docker_context\
[](fg:#a1dab4 bg:#a1dab4)\
$character\
"""

# Disable the blank line at the start of the prompt
# add_newline = false

# You can also replace your username with a neat symbol like  to save some space
[username]
show_always = true
style_user = "bg:#253494"
style_root = "bg:#253494"
format = '[$user ]($style)'

[directory]
style = "bg:#2c7fb8"
format = "[ $path ]($style)"
repo_root_style = "bold white bg:#2c7fb8"
repo_root_format = "[ $before_root_path]($style)[$repo_root]($repo_root_style)[$path ]($style)"
fish_style_pwd_dir_length = 2
truncation_length = 1

[docker_context]
symbol = " "
style = "bg:#a1dab4"
format = '[ $symbol $context ]($style) $path'

[git_branch]
symbol = ""
style = "bg:#41b6c4"
format = '[ $symbol $branch ]($style)'

[git_status]
format = "[$all_status$ahead_behind]($style)"
ahead = "⇡$count "
behind = "⇣$count "
deleted = "D$count "
diverged = " $count "
stashed = "📦$count "
modified = "M$count "
staged = 'S$count ](green)'
renamed = "R$count "
untracked = "U$count "
style = "bg:#41b6c4"

# Displays text, typically a single character,
# based on the status of the previous command.
[character]
success_symbol = "[](bg:#a1dab4 fg:#a1dab4)[](fg:#a1dab4)"
#success_symbol = "[▶](bold green)" # normal prompt
error_symbol = "[](#a1dab4 bg:#f03b20)[](fg:#f03b20)" # used if previous command failed

[julia]
symbol = " "
style = "bg:#86BBD8"
format = '[ $symbol ($version) ]($style)'

[time]
disabled = true
time_format = "%R" # Hour:Minute Format
style = "bg:#33658A"
format = '[ ♥ $time ]($style)'

```

Can confirm this behavior: ``` [directory] fish_style_pwd_dir_length = 1 repo_root_format = "at [$before_root_path]($style)[$repo_root]($repo_root_style)[$path]($repo_root_style) " repo_root_style = "bold fg:244" style = "bold fg:33" truncation_length = 0 truncate_to_repo = true ``` Now change `truncation_length = 1` #### Environment - Starship version: `starship 1.11.0` - Shell type: `zsh` - Shell version: `zsh 5.9 (x86_64-apple-darwin21.3.0)` - Shell plugin manager: n/a - Terminal emulator: Alacritty - Operating system: macOS 12.6
Hey @davidkna @matchai @andytom, any updates on this one?
